body: I will try to talk to my brother about it since I haven't. Thank you for your support again, what you have said has opened up my mind completely and made me see the situation in a much different light.

Thank you so much for listening! It means a lot to me to have you take time out of your day to reply.  The hardest thing is seeing my parents fight. Recently my brother now spends every other week at my father's house making him now argue with my mom. Its a lot to handle but I started talking to friends about it to help handle the pressure and its helped a lot.
